mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_turn_freeze (thread_id, turn_id, binding_id, reason, failover_count, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{threadId}, #{turnId}, #{bindingId}, #{reason}, 0, 'system', 'system') ON CONFLICT (thread_id, turn_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT thread_id AS threadId, turn_id AS turnId, binding_id AS bindingId, reason, failover_count AS failoverCount FROM model_turn_freeze WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY create_at
mapper.update: UPDATE model_turn_freeze SET binding_id = #{bindingId}, reason = #{reason}, failover_count = COALESCE(failover_count, 0) + 1, update_by = 'system', update_at = now() WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND turn_id = #{turnId}
